label: Kevin's Ramen & Boba (portfolio demos/room)

capture.note: Honor quality preset capture.dpr. Photosphere: detach OrbitControls (enabled=false, no update), no vignette on cube faces, reject-black before save.

photosphere.label: ramen-hq
photosphere.note: Plaza eye in front of kiosk; look −Z for storefront. Face size from preset photosphere.size (social 1024 / print 2048 / archive 3072). Host: OrbitControls detached, post off, Node bilinear stitch.

4d.note: Default showcase: fixed-eye live orbit (--orbit live) so steam/lights animate; encode ~6–12 fps for ≥4s loop. --orbit yaw only when explicit (never default).

scripts.syncDemo: node -e "console.log('From 4dps package: npm run demo (syncs ramen-hq then ramen-demo into demo/assets)')"

validation.note: Fail CI / ship if equirect mean/std below rejectBlackMean or 4D motion below MAD threshold. Do not use plaza-photosphere as demo fallback.

notes: Set PORTFOLIO_ROOM to demos/room absolute path. Showcase: --quality social (default) or print. Host must fix OrbitControls detach + stitch UV + multi-frame live 4D; then 7dps grid/encode/view. Demo defaultYaw 180deg toward kiosk.
